payout_quote: The referring member gets $50 for each successful referral. Reward: $50, deposited into the referring member's Regular Share Account during the next calendar month.
steps: Be a Forest Area Federal Credit Union member in good standing
Fill out the referral form and identify the referral when your friend opens their account (referral must be identified at account opening)
Friend opens and funds a new Regular Share Account (new member: not a FAFCU member within the previous 6 months)
You receive $50 deposited into your Regular Share Account during the next calendar month
catches: Referral must be identified at account opening — late claims not accepted
New member must not have been a FAFCU member within the previous 6 months
Referring member must be in good standing
Rewards paid within 30 days after qualifications are met (paid the next calendar month)
Bonuses may be reported for tax purposes
Program may be modified or discontinued at any time
biggest_catch: You get a solid $50 per referral — but your friend must name you at account opening and cannot have been a member in the last 6 months.
eligibility: Forest Area FCU members in good standing; referred friends must be new members (not a member within previous 6 months)
timing: Reward deposited during the next calendar month after qualifications are met
